heroTitle: Turn Your Traffic Into Long-Term Revenue
heroSubtitle: Promote a full iGaming brand — slots, live casino, and sports betting — with transparent tracking, flexible commission models, and monthly USD payouts.
commissionSubtitle: Choose the deal structure that matches your traffic quality and monetization strategy. Custom rates are negotiated based on volume, GEO, and acquisition channel.
revshareDesc: Earn an ongoing percentage of Net Gaming Revenue (NGR) from referred players. RevShare is calculated on cash gameplay GGR minus bonus cost — aligned with real player value.
revsharePoint1: Lifetime revenue share on qualified player activity
revsharePoint2: Transparent GGR, bonus cost, and NGR breakdown in your portal
revsharePoint3: Ideal for SEO, content, and community-driven traffic
cpaDesc: Receive a fixed one-time payment when a referred player completes a qualifying first deposit. Perfect when you need predictable upfront returns.
cpaPoint1: Single payout triggered on first qualifying deposit
cpaPoint3: Best for paid media and high-volume acquisition funnels
hybridDesc: Combine an upfront CPA with ongoing RevShare on the same player. Balance immediate cash flow with long-tail earnings from active players.
hybridPoint1: CPA on first deposit plus RevShare on future activity
hybridPoint2: Flexible split tailored to your traffic profile
hybridPoint3: Popular with influencers and mixed-channel partners
benefitsSubtitle: We invest in conversion, retention, and product depth so your referrals keep playing — and you keep earning.
benefit1Desc: Promote slots, live dealer tables, crash games, and sports betting from one brand — more ways to convert every visitor.
benefit2Desc: Track referred players, deposits, turnover, GGR, bonus cost, NGR, and commission accruals from a dedicated dashboard.
benefit3Desc: Top-level partners can create and manage sub-affiliates with controlled commission models and performance visibility.
benefit4Desc: Closed-month commissions become available for payout in USD via bank transfer, crypto, or e-wallet — subject to minimum thresholds.
benefit5Desc: KYC, AML, and responsible gaming standards protect the brand and help maintain long-term player trust and retention.
benefit6Desc: Work directly with our partnerships team for deal terms, creatives, landing pages, and campaign optimization support.
howSubtitle: From application to payout in four straightforward steps.
step1Desc: Email partners@ibets24.com with your traffic sources, target markets, and promotional methods. We review fit and compliance before onboarding.
step2Desc: Approved partners get a unique referral code, tracking link, and access to the Affiliate Portal with live performance reporting.
step3Desc: Send traffic through your link or code. Players must register and meet eligibility requirements under our Terms and KYC policies.
step4Desc: Monitor player stats daily, refine campaigns, and request monthly payouts once closed-month commissions reach the minimum threshold.
portalTitle: Everything You Need in One Portal
portalSubtitle: Existing affiliates sign in to manage referrals, stats, and payouts.
portalFeature1: Referral link and code with copy-ready sharing
portalFeature2: Player-level statistics with custom date ranges
portalFeature3: Commission history and available payout balance
portalFeature4: Payout details and withdrawal requests in USD
businessDesc: Beyond affiliates, we collaborate with licensed game providers, payment solution partners, marketing agencies, and technology vendors who share our standards for fairness, security, and responsible gaming.
ctaSubtitle: Tell us about your audience and traffic channels. Our team will respond with tailored commission terms and next steps.
supportNote: For player account, payment, or bonus issues, please contact support@ibets24.com — not the partners inbox.
